Container.Name: Cypht-AIO
Container.Overview: All-in-One Cypht 2.12.0 Webmail with native REST API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) AI server.
Container.Requires: Connect to MySQL and Redis as configured in environment variables, or use default local storage.

Config.Name: Cypht Webmail Port
Config.Description: Host port for Cypht native Webmail UI.

Config.Name: Gateway REST API Port
Config.Description: Host port for Cypht Gateway REST API and Management UI.

Config.Name: MCP Server Port
Config.Description: Host port for Streamable HTTP MCP server (/mcp).

Config.Name: Gateway Data
Config.Description: Persistent directory for Gateway database, tokens, audit logs, and keys.

Config.Name: Cypht Users Data
Config.Description: Persistent directory for Cypht user configuration files.

Config.Name: Cypht Attachments Data
Config.Description: Persistent directory for temporary email attachments.

Config.Name: Cypht App Data
Config.Description: Persistent directory for Cypht cache and session storage.

Config.Name: API Login Key
Config.Description: Optional custom secret key for API login. If omitted, an unguessable key is auto-generated in gateway data.

Config.Name: Gateway Bridge Key
Config.Description: Optional custom secret key for Bridge. If omitted, an unguessable key is auto-generated in gateway data.

Config.Name: Gateway Master Key
Config.Description: Optional custom master key for token encryption. If omitted, auto-generated in gateway data.
